ja.business: 光でデータを送る部品や装置を作る会社。AIデータセンター向けの光通信に加え、加工用レーザーも扱う。
ja.revenue: 通信向けレーザーや光信号を送受信するモジュール、工場で使うレーザーなどの販売。

en.risks: Major-customer order changes, pricing pressure, production-ramp delays and excess inventory if demand falls short.
en.competition: Optical-component, module and laser manufacturers, plus customers that develop competing products in-house.
en.relationships: Supplies cloud providers and network-equipment makers; received an investment from NVIDIA in March 2026.

en.risks: Customer and smartphone exposure, licensing disputes and competing with customers through its own chips.
en.competition: The x86 architecture used by Intel and AMD, open RISC-V and proprietary customer technologies.
en.relationships: Works with chipmakers, device makers and design or manufacturing partners; SoftBank is the controlling shareholder.

en.risks: Export restrictions, constrained manufacturing capacity and customers adopting their own chips.
en.competition: AMD, Intel and custom AI chips developed by Google, Amazon and others.
en.relationships: TSMC and others manufacture its chips; SK hynix, Micron and Samsung supply memory.

ja.business: データを一時的に扱うDRAMや、保存するNANDなどのメモリー半導体を作る会社。

en.business: Makes DRAM for working memory and NAND for data storage.
en.revenue: Sells memory and storage products for data centers, phones, PCs and other devices.
en.strength: Designs and manufactures memory, including high-bandwidth memory (HBM) for AI.
en.risks: Memory-price cycles, oversupply and heavy factory investment can pressure earnings.
en.competition: Samsung and SK hynix; Kioxia and Sandisk also compete in NAND.
en.relationships: Supplies memory to NVIDIA and serves cloud and device manufacturers.

ja.risks: メモリーメーカーの設備投資が減ると受注が揺れやすい。中国向け輸出規制や新工程での競争も販売機会を左右する。
ja.competition: 成膜ではApplied MaterialsやASM International、削る工程では東京エレクトロンなどと競う。競合は工程によって異なる。
ja.relationships: TSMC、Micron、Samsung、SK hynixが主要顧客。装置と保守を通じて、受託製造とメモリー生産の両方を支える。

en.business: Builds tools that deposit thin films, etch patterns and clean surfaces for memory and advanced chips.
en.revenue: Sells equipment, replacement parts, maintenance and upgrades to chipmakers.
en.strength: Precision processing handles demanding three-dimensional structures. Qualified production tools and ongoing support anchor customer relationships.
en.risks: Memory investment cycles, China export controls and competition for new process steps can reduce orders.
en.competition: Competes with Applied Materials and ASM International in deposition, and Tokyo Electron in etching, among others.
en.relationships: Major customers include TSMC, Micron, Samsung and SK hynix, spanning foundry and memory manufacturing.

ja.business: 半導体の微小な欠陥を見つけ、寸法や膜の厚さを測る装置の会社。不良の原因を早く捉え、工場で良品を増やす手助けをする。
ja.revenue: 主力は半導体工場向けの検査・測定装置。保守契約でも収入を得ており、電子基板やチップの組み立て工程向けにも展開する。
ja.strength: 光学技術と測定・解析ソフトを組み合わせ、開発から量産まで不良を管理できる。複雑になるチップの品質改善を支える。
ja.risks: 大口顧客の設備投資と中国向け輸出規制に左右される。専用部品の供給不足や競合製品の進歩も納入と採算を脅かす。
ja.competition: Applied Materials、ASML、日立ハイテク、レーザーテック、Onto Innovationなど。検査・測定の製品ごとに競合が異なる。
ja.relationships: TSMCは年次開示に名前が載る大口顧客。半導体メーカーへ検査・測定装置を納め、工場での品質管理と保守を支える。

en.business: Makes tools that detect tiny chip defects and measure dimensions and film thickness, helping factories improve yields.
en.revenue: Earns from semiconductor inspection and measurement tools, service contracts, and systems for packaging and circuit boards.
en.strength: Combines optics, measurement and analytical software to control defects from development through volume production.
en.risks: Major-customer spending, China export controls, specialized-parts shortages and competing technologies can hurt deliveries and profitability.
en.competition: Competitors include Applied Materials, ASML, Hitachi High-Tech, Lasertec and Onto Innovation; rivals vary by product.
en.relationships: TSMC is a disclosed major customer. KLA supplies chipmakers with inspection, measurement and ongoing factory support.
